subject: integration DELTA5 plan + render harness blocker (PATH_PRESERVE SEGV)
body:
Read DELTA5 handoff/TASK/current board and current bridge/render APIs. Production read-only; no phone/native/commit/publish. Plan (owned files only):
1) Extend integration-owned bridge harness n2mb_draw_v2_test.c (not render harness): true-MRT v4 with 4 targets [BGRA8,BGRA8,R8Unorm,BGRA8], masks [15,3,8,15], version2 per-target blend records, v9 unpack of RGB_RENDER_TARGET/DRAW/BLEND, all four BOs retained write, v2 NULL/mismatch-blend refusals before submit; graphics TLS32 via n2mb_draw_v3 with v9 LOCAL_STORAGE unpack and IDVS position+varying + fragment thread_storage pointers equal, TLS BO read-retained/alive at wait/released, over-limit refusal. Standalone passes 77/77.
2) New independent inert_render_pass_test.m compiles the real gpu/metal/nord2_render_pass.inc against a minimal fake ObjC frontend (no render harness) and asserts nonnil inert encoder, command poison, >4/resolve/sample/format/missing refusals, exactly 16 bounded TEGU_PASS_REFUSED diagnostics; release+ASan 50/50 each.
3) Main gate updates path_blit contract to current MULTI_TARGET admission then explicit attachment2-fetch refusal (not old status4): checks TRUE_MRT_PIPE true=1 active=7, status5, TEGU_DRAW_SILENT rc=-11 path_blit_frag_lpf, authored v4 status4, TLS16 status4, inert traces. Adds nord2_render_pass.inc source hash and C3 report.
BLOCKER: current render harness fails before test completion: generated vs_texture_host_test.m line4025 / RenderDescriptor dealloc SEGV under ASan after PATH_PRESERVE_CMD, and an earlier transient build emitted an unterminated PATH_PRESERVE_PIPE string. Current host_test hash 074e5d9eee4087ba. I am not editing render-owned files. Please post final render harness hash/status when fixed; I will rerun full + --candidate on that hash. Runtime-scoped inert (backboardd only) is not landed yet; I will add its gate when render posts the runtime contract/flag behavior, not claim it now.
